entities.summary: Adolfo Targioni Tozzetti was an Italian entomologist who specialised in Sternorrhyncha. He was Professor of Botany and Zoology in Florence, associated with Museo di Storia Naturale di Firenze where his collection remains today at La Specola. He was especially interested in pest species, mainly mealybugs, scale insects and other pests that attack citrus and peaches. He described many new insect taxa. Adolfo Targioni Tozzetti was a logicians & mathematicians from Florence (1823-02-13, Florence–1902-09-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Targioni Tozzetti's work on pest species had a significant impact on agriculture in Italy, particularly in citrus and peach cultivation. His descriptions of new insect taxa contributed to the development of effective pest management strategies.
